Singleton-permitting blocked edge-coloured linear Gaussian DAG models over \(V\). A state \(E_0=(G_{E_0},\Pi^{E_0})\) pairs an acyclic graph on \(V\) with, for every target \(j\), a partition \(\Pi^{E_0}_j\) of \(\operatorname{pa}_{G_{E_0}}(j)\) into nonempty coefficient blocks, singletons permitted. Its parameter space is \(\Theta_{E_0}=\mathbb R^{b_{E_0}}\times(0,\infty)^p\) with \(b_{E_0}=\sum_j|\Pi^{E_0}_j|\): one unrestricted real coefficient per block and one positive innovation variance per vertex. The block-constant matrix \(B_{E_0}(\beta)\) has \((B_{E_0}(\beta))_{ji}=\beta_{jB}\) for \(i\in B\in\Pi^{E_0}_j\) and zero at nonparents, and the covariance map is \(\phi_{E_0}(\beta,\omega)=(I_p-B_{E_0}(\beta))^{-1}\operatorname{diag}(\omega)(I_p-B_{E_0}(\beta))^{-\mathsf T}\), whose full image \(\mathcal M(E_0)\subseteq\mathbb S^p_{++}\) is the observational model. Population objects live over an arbitrary \(\Sigma\in\mathbb S^p_{++}\): parent regressions \(r_j(P;\Sigma)=\Sigma_{P,P}^{-1}\Sigma_{P,j}\), block-constrained regressions, determinant and cleared-regression certificates, unit-noise binary-star covariances, and legal singleton covered reversals with partition transport. No probability space, no faithfulness assumption, no restriction to nonzero coefficients. — The blocked (target-local edge-coloured) layer is genuinely new: no Causalean or Mathlib object carries a per-target partition of parent sets with block-constant structural coefficients. It is built ON TOP of S1 (`BlockedState.toDAG`) so the graph coordinate is never rebuilt. The directed graph \(\mathcal K\) is acyclic.

review.note: Absence of a nonempty transitive edge path from any vertex to itself is equivalent to acyclicity of the directed graph.

standard.name: Directed acyclicity
standard.citation: David Maxwell Chickering. A Transformational Characterization of Equivalent Bayesian Network Structures. Proceedings of the Eleventh Conference on Uncertainty in Artificial Intelligence, 87--98, 1995.

nl.statement: For every \(j\in V\), \(\Xi_j\) is a partition of \(\operatorname{pa}_{\mathcal K}(j)\), with singleton blocks permitted.

review.note: Nonempty blocks, containment in the parent set, and unique block membership for every parent are jointly equivalent to each Xi_j being a partition of exactly pa_K(j), with singleton blocks allowed.

standard.name: Blocked target-local edge colouring with a singleton-permitting variant
standard.citation: Tobias Boege, Kaie Kubjas, Pratik Misra, and Liam Solus. Coloured Gaussian Directed Acyclic Graphical Models. Journal of the Royal Statistical Society: Series B, 88:819--875, 2026. DOI: 10.1093/jrsssb/qkaf068; arXiv:2404.04024v3.

nl.statement: \[\mathfrak S_p=\left\{A=(\mathcal K,\Xi):\mathcal K\text{ is an acyclic directed graph on }V,\ \Xi_j\text{ is a partition of }\operatorname{pa}_{\mathcal K}(j)\text{ for every }j\in V\right\}.\]

review.note: The structure is equivalent to a directed acyclic relation on V equipped at every target with a partition of exactly its parent set; the decidability field is conservative on finite V.

nl.statement: For \(E_0\in\mathfrak S_p\), let \(b_{E_0}=\sum_{j\in V}|\Pi^{E_0}_j|\), \(\Theta_{E_0}=\mathbb R^{b_{E_0}}\times(0,\infty)^p\), and \[\mathcal M(E_0)=\left\{(I_p-B_{E_0}(\beta_{E_0}))^{-1}\operatorname{diag}(\omega_{E_0})(I_p-B_{E_0}(\beta_{E_0}))^{-\mathsf T}:(\beta_{E_0},\omega_{E_0})\in\Theta_{E_0}\right\}.\] The entry \((B_{E_0}(\beta_{E_0}))_{ji}\) equals \(\beta_{jB}\) for \(i\in B\in\Pi^{E_0}_j\), and all real block coefficients are admitted.

review.note: After unfolding covParam, paramSpace, BlockCoefficients, and coefMatrix, Set.range gives exactly the stated covariance image over unrestricted real block coefficients and strictly positive vertex variances.
Filtering E.blocks j by 2 ≤ B.card is exactly the family of blocks in Π_j^{E₀} having cardinality at least two.
The filtered pairs are exactly the directed edges i→j of E whose endpoint nonsingleton block families differ.
The four structure fields faithfully encode the skeleton, unshielded colliders, vertex-indexed nonsingleton families, and family-mismatch edge set.

nl.statement: For a rejected state \(J\), an ordered conditional-independence certificate chooses a topological order \(\pi_J\), a nonadjacent pair \(u,v\) with \(u\) preceding \(v\), and \(S=\operatorname{Pred}_{\pi_J}(v)\setminus\{u\}\), and evaluates \(f_{uvS}(\Sigma)=\det(\Sigma_{[u,S],[v,S]})\). A blocked-regression certificate chooses \(j\in V\) and distinct \(u,v\) in one block of \(\Pi^J_j\), puts \(P=\operatorname{pa}_{G_J}(j)\), and evaluates \(L_{j;u,v}(\Sigma)=(e_u-e_v)^{\mathsf T}\operatorname{adj}(\Sigma_{P,P})\Sigma_{P,j}\).

review.note: The constructors enforce distinctness, nonadjacency, topological precedence, the prescribed predecessor set and common ordering, or same-block membership, and the two evaluation branches equal the stated determinant and adjugate-cleared regression difference.

nl.statement: For \(E_0\in\mathfrak S_p\), choose \(z\in V\) and \(\mathcal A_z\subseteq\Pi^{E_0}_z\) with \(1\leq|\mathcal A_z|\leq2\), set \(A_z=\bigcup_{B\in\mathcal A_z}B\), \(B^{\star}=e_z\mathbf 1_{A_z}^{\mathsf T}\), and \[\Sigma^{\star}=(I_p+B^{\star})(I_p+B^{\star})^{\mathsf T}=I_p+e_z\mathbf 1_{A_z}^{\mathsf T}+\mathbf 1_{A_z}e_z^{\mathsf T}+|A_z|e_ze_z^{\mathsf T}.\] The set of all such covariances is \(\mathcal W_2(E_0)\).

review.note: activeChoices selects exactly one or two blocks at a target, activeUnion forms their union, and starCovariance is precisely (I+B★)(I+B★)ᵀ for B★=e_z 1_Aᵀ.

nl.statement: Order vertices, blocks, and pairs lexicographically. For \(\mathsf S(C)\neq\mathsf S(D)\), \(\mathsf{Route}(C,D)\) applies the first available rule: a skeleton mismatch activates the source block containing the differing arrow tail and returns the rejected ordered conditional-independence certificate; a collider mismatch activates the source block or two source blocks containing the collider parents and returns the rejected ordered conditional-independence certificate; a nonsingleton-family mismatch chooses crossing edge-support partition atoms, activates the source atom, and returns the rejected within-block regression certificate; an \(F\)-mismatch chooses a reversed \(x\to y\) with \(\mathcal N_x\neq\mathcal N_y\), selects a direction in which a block \(S\in\mathcal N_x\) is split by \(\Pi^E_y\), activates \(\{x\}\) and the first block \(T\in\Pi^E_y\) meeting but not containing \(S\), and returns the rejected regression difference between the first elements of \(S\cap T\) and \(S\setminus T\).

review.note: Unfolding executeRoute and IsRouteExecution yields the four priority branches with coherent vertex-derived lexicographic minima, cross-center family atoms, and split-eligible orientation/block choices, returning exactly the prescribed active blocks and rejected CI or regression certificate.

nl.statement: For \(i\to j\) in \(G_{E_0}\), \(\operatorname{rev}_{i\to j}(E_0)\) is defined exactly when \(\operatorname{pa}_{G_{E_0}}(j)=\operatorname{pa}_{G_{E_0}}(i)\cup\{i\}\), \(\{i\}\in\Pi^{E_0}_j\), and \(\Pi^{E_0}_j\setminus\{\{i\}\}=\Pi^{E_0}_i\). It reverses \(i\to j\), sets \(\Pi'_j=\Pi^{E_0}_i\) and \(\Pi'_i=\Pi^{E_0}_i\cup\{\{j\}\}\), and leaves every other partition unchanged.

review.note: IsCoveredEdge is equivalent to the stated parent-set equality, and reversedBlocks performs exactly the prescribed endpoint update while leaving all other partitions unchanged.

nl.statement: \[\mathcal R(E_0)=\{E'\in\mathfrak S_p:E'\text{ is reached from }E_0\text{ by a finite sequence of defined }\operatorname{rev}_{i\to j}\}.\]

review.note: ReflTransGen of ReversalStep is exactly reachability by a finite, possibly empty, sequence of defined legal reversals.

nl.statement: Form the ordinary CPDAG of \(G\), orient every arrow in \(F(C)\), apply closure under the standard consistent-extension rules, and enumerate every acyclic extension \(K\) with the same unshielded colliders. For each extension emit the unique lift \(E_K=(K,\Pi^K)\) with \[\Pi^K_j=\mathcal N_j(C)\cup\left\{\{a\}:a\in\operatorname{pa}_K(j)\setminus\bigcup\mathcal N_j(C)\right\},\qquad j\in V.\] The emitted set is \(\operatorname{Enum}(C)\).

review.note: The extensional filter enumerates exactly the acyclic same-skeleton, same-collider extensions retaining F(C), while IsCanonicalLift and liftBlocks implement the stated unique partition lift.

nl.statement: Fix \(E_0\in\mathfrak S_p\), \(\Sigma\in\mathbb S^p_{++}\), and \(j\in V\). Put \(P_{E_0j}=\operatorname{pa}_{G_{E_0}}(j)\). Let \(A_{E_0j}\) have rows \(i\in P_{E_0j}\), columns \(B\in\Pi^{E_0}_j\), and entries \((A_{E_0j})_{iB}=\mathbf 1\{i\in B\}\). For a nonempty parent set define \(\Gamma_{E_0j}(\Sigma)=A_{E_0j}^{\mathsf T}\Sigma_{P_{E_0j},P_{E_0j}}A_{E_0j}\), \(h_{E_0j}(\Sigma)=A_{E_0j}^{\mathsf T}\Sigma_{P_{E_0j},j}\), and \(\beta_{E_0j}(\Sigma)=\Gamma_{E_0j}(\Sigma)^{-1}h_{E_0j}(\Sigma)\). Repeat each block coefficient on its member parents and put zero outside the parent set to obtain \(L_{E_0}(\Sigma)\); use a zero row for an empty parent set.

review.note: On exactly the positive-definite domain, blockLS unfolds to the stated incidence matrix, Gram system, score, inverse coefficient vector, blockwise repetition, and zero row when the parent partition is empty. | Unfolding blockLSFormula, fittedBlockCoefficient, blockScore, blockGram, and blockIncidence gives exactly AᵀΣ_PP A, AᵀΣ_Pj, Γ⁻¹h, and blockwise coefficient repetition; the partition constraints force an empty block family exactly when the parent set is empty, so the corresponding row is zero.

nl.statement: For \(E_0\in\mathfrak S_p\), set \(d_{E_0}=p+\sum_{j\in V}|\Pi^{E_0}_j|\). If \(S_n\in\mathbb S^p_{++}\), compute the attained statewise Gaussian likelihood using the target-local systems in \(\texttt{def:off-model-block-ls}\) and set \(\operatorname{BIC}_n(E_0)=-2\sup_{\Sigma\in\mathcal M(E_0)}\ell_n(\Sigma)+d_{E_0}\log n\). If \(S_n\notin\mathbb S^p_{++}\), set \(\operatorname{BIC}_n(E_0)=d_{E_0}\log n\). Let \(\widehat C_n\) be the minimizer under a fixed ordering of \(\mathfrak S_p\).

review.note: The positive-definite branch is the normalized negative twice maximized centered-Gaussian likelihood plus the stated dimension penalty, the non-positive-definite fallback is exactly the penalty, and selectedState separately implements the fixed-rank argmin.

nl.statement: For \(E_0\in\mathfrak S_p\), \(\Sigma\in\mathbb S^p_{++}\), and finite \(\mathcal Q\), define \(g_{E'}(\Sigma)=(((I_p-L_{E'}(\Sigma))^{-1})_{ya})_{(a,y)\in\mathcal Q}\) for each \(E'\in\mathcal R(E_0)\), and set \[\mathcal T_{E_0}(\Sigma)=\{g_{E'}(\Sigma):E'\in\mathcal R(E_0)\}.\]

review.note: The image over the legal-reversal component is exactly the paper effect set; the unequal-pair subtype enforces the query domain, and zero-extension off the finite query menu is a two-way conservative representation. | Lean is a faithful zero-extension encoding of the paper's Q-indexed vectors: restriction to Q recovers exactly ((I − L_E′(Sigma))⁻¹)_{ya}, every such vector has the unique zero extension used by effectVector, and the image ranges over exactly the finite legal-reversal reachability set R(E₀).

nl.statement: For \(C\in\mathfrak S_p\), \(\mathcal E_C\) is the finite union, over \(D\in\mathfrak S_p\) with \(d_D\leq d_C\) and \(\mathcal M(D)\neq\mathcal M(C)\), of the polynomial pullbacks to \(\Theta_C\) of \(\mathcal M(C)\cap\mathcal M(D)\), together with the polynomial zero-gradient loci of the nonconstant coordinates reported by \(\mathcal T_C\).

review.note: The first comprehension is exactly the parameter pullback of each unequal lower-dimensional model intersection, while the second ranges over precisely the nonconstant queried component coordinates and their zero-gradient loci.

nl.statement: Select \(\widehat C_n\) by \(\texttt{def:global-bic}\). On \(S_n\in\mathbb S^p_{++}\), retain member labels, evaluate every rational map \(g_E(S_n)\) and its derivative, estimate its variance from the Gaussian covariance limit, and use Bonferroni critical value \(z_{1-\alpha/(2K)}\) for the \(K\) nonconstant labelled coordinates; assign exact singleton intervals to structurally zero coordinates. On \(S_n\notin\mathbb S^p_{++}\), assign \(\mathbb R\) to every coordinate. The resulting collection is \(\mathfrak I_{n,\alpha}(\widehat C_n)\).

review.note: The definition implements the selected-component labelled intervals, Gaussian plug-in variance, Bonferroni critical value over nonconstant labels, structural-zero singletons, and the universal singular-covariance fallback.

nl.statement: Apply \(\mathsf H_{\mathrm{opt}}\): restrict universal separator schemes to minimal crossing-partition and unequal-family reversal subinstances, translate active-block support into regression support rank, and use exact determinant divisibility and rational-height counting to lower-bound jointly the number of active blocks and the largest numerical height.

review.note: The nonassertive string records the same restricted subinstances, support-rank translation, determinant-divisibility argument, rational-height counting, and joint lower-bound objective, while correctly disclosing that the unresolved scheme and height conventions are not asserted. | The closed String preserves every strategy clause—both restricted subinstance families, the support-rank translation, and the joint determinant/divisibility height route—while its disclaimer faithfully records that the handle is nonassertive.

nl.statement:
Fix \(z\in V\) and \(A_z\subseteq V\setminus\{z\}\), and let \(\Sigma^{\star}=I_p+e_z\mathbf 1_{A_z}^{\mathsf T}+\mathbf 1_{A_z}e_z^{\mathsf T}+|A_z|e_ze_z^{\mathsf T}\). For \(j\in V\) and \(P\subseteq V\setminus\{j\}\), write \(r=r_j(P;\Sigma^{\star})\). If \(j=z\), then \(r_q=\mathbf 1\{q\in A_z\}\) for \(q\in P\). If \(j
eq z\) and either \(z
otin P\) or \(j
otin A_z\), then \(r=0\). If \(j\in A_z\) and \(z\in P\), put \(Q=P\setminus\{z\}\) and \(d=1+|A_z\setminus Q|\); then \(r_z=1/d\), \(r_q=-1/d\) for \(q\in A_z\cap Q\), \(r_q=0\) for \(q\in Q\setminus A_z\), and \(\det(\Sigma^{\star}_{P,P})=d\).

review.note: After unfolding starCovariance and regCoef, Lean gives exactly the displayed star covariance, all three regression cases, and the principal determinant; the extra j ≠ z premise in the third case follows from j ∈ Az and z ∉ Az.

nl.statement: For all \(C,D\in\mathfrak S_p\) with \(\mathsf S(C)\neq\mathsf S(D)\), \(\mathsf{Route}(C,D)\) returns \(E\in\{C,D\}\), \(J\in\{C,D\}\setminus\{E\}\), \(z\in V\), and \(\mathcal A_z\subseteq\Pi^E_z\) with \(1\leq|\mathcal A_z|\leq2\). With every innovation variance equal to one, every block coefficient in \(E\) equal to one on \(\mathcal A_z\) and zero elsewhere, and \(A_z=\bigcup_{B\in\mathcal A_z}B\), the resulting covariance satisfies \[B^{\star}=e_z\mathbf 1_{A_z}^{\mathsf T},\qquad (B^{\star})^2=0,\qquad \Sigma^{\star}=(I_p+B^{\star})(I_p+B^{\star})^{\mathsf T}\in\mathcal M(E)\setminus\mathcal M(J).\] Every entry of \(\Sigma^{\star}\) is an integer in \(\{0,1,\ldots,p\}\), \(\det(\Sigma^{\star})=1\), and the router returns either an ordered certificate \(f_{uvS}(\Sigma^{\star})\) or a blocked-regression certificate \(L_{j;u,v}(\Sigma^{\star})\) whose value belongs to \(\{-2,-1,1,2\}\). Every recovered regression coefficient in the certificate has numerator in \(\{-1,0,1\}\) and reduced denominator at most \(p\), so all supplied numerical data have height at most \(B(p)=\lceil\log_2p\rceil\). The route uses polynomially many graph and rational-arithmetic operations in \(p\). For \(p=1\), the implication is vacuous.

review.note: After unfolding the route, validity, star, covariance-model, certificate, regression-bound, and execution predicates, Lean preserves both directions: it returns the two ordered states, one-or-two source blocks, the unit-noise binary star, exact model separation and arithmetic bounds, while the coupled trace bound supplies the stated uniform polynomial operation guarantee.

nl.statement: For all \(C,D\in\mathfrak S_p\), the following are equivalent: \(\mathcal M(C)=\mathcal M(D)\); \(\mathsf S(C)=\mathsf S(D)\); and \(D\in\mathcal R(C)\). Every legal reversal preserves the full covariance image, including zero coefficients. If these conditions hold, then \(d_{\mathrm{rev}}(C,D)=\delta(C,D)\), and a shortest path reverses every initially disagreeing arrow exactly once. Thus the signature is an exact recovery functional for the covariance-model component, not merely a sufficient invariant.

review.note: The two chained biconditionals express equivalence of all three conditions; legal reversals preserve the full unrestricted covariance image; and, under those equivalent conditions, revDist equals arrowGap while HasExactDisagreementReversalChain supplies a shortest chain reversing each initial disagreement exactly once.

nl.statement: For every \(C\in\mathfrak S_p\), \[\operatorname{Enum}(C)=\mathcal R(C)=\{D\in\mathfrak S_p:\mathsf S(D)=\mathsf S(C)\}.\] Each consistent extension of the ordinary CPDAG with the background arrows \(F(C)\) has exactly one lifted partition, so the enumeration is duplicate-free and terminates after at most \(p!\) outputs. A shortest legal-reversal path from \(C\) to each emitted \(D\) has length \(\delta(C,D)\).

review.note: After unfolding the referenced definitions, Lean gives both component equalities, the unique canonical partition lift for every skeleton/collider-compatible extension retaining F(C), the p! output bound, and an attained shortest legal-reversal chain of length δ(C,D).

nl.statement: If every block of \(C\) is a singleton, then \(\mathcal N_j(C)=\varnothing\) for every \(j\in V\), and graph projection is a bijection from \(\mathcal R(C)\) onto the ordinary Markov-equivalence class of \(G\); the inverse sends each equivalent DAG to its unique all-singleton lift.  If every nonempty block of \(C\) is nonsingleton, then \(\mathcal R(C)=\{C\}\).  The first conclusion is the singleton lift of the Chickering1995 covered-reversal component, and the second is the target-local proper-blocked structural-identifiability conclusion covered by BoegeKubjasMisraSolus2026.

review.note: After unfolding the block predicates, nonsingleton family, reversal component, and covariance model, Lean states both endpoint reductions equivalently; its explicit proper-block covariance-identifiability conjunct is the cited target-local consequence and also follows from component singletonness via complete_blocked_equivalence.

nl.statement: Fix \(p\), \(C\in\mathfrak S_p\), and \(\theta_C\in\Theta_C\setminus\mathcal E_C\), and put \(\Sigma_0=\phi_C(\theta_C)\). Let \(X^{(1)},\ldots,X^{(n)}\) be independent \(N_p(0,\Sigma_0)\) observations, and let \(\widehat C_n\) minimize \(\operatorname{BIC}_n\) over \(\mathfrak S_p\) under the fixed tie rule. The set \(\mathcal E_C\) is a proper algebraic subset of \(\Theta_C\), and as \(n\to\infty\) with fixed \(p\), \[\Pr\{\mathcal R(\widehat C_n)=\mathcal R(C)\}\longrightarrow1.\] The result concerns the global criterion and makes no claim about greedy-search consistency.

review.note: After unfolding the exception set, proper-algebraic predicate, Gaussian IID world, covariance parametrization, global fixed-tie BIC selector, empirical covariance, and reversal component, the Lean statement exactly expresses properness of the stated exceptional locus and pointwise fixed-p global-BIC component recovery in probability; Q is the explicit parameter of the paper-defined exceptional set.

nl.statement: Under \(\texttt{thm:generic-bic-component-recovery}\), fix finite \(\mathcal Q\) and \(\alpha\in(0,1)\). Then \(\mathcal T_{\widehat C_n}(S_n)\) converges in probability to \(\mathcal T_C(\Sigma_0)\) in Hausdorff distance. Retaining state labels before removing coincident numerical values, the confidence collection satisfies \[\liminf_{n\to\infty}\Pr\left\{\mathcal R(\widehat C_n)=\mathcal R(C)\text{ and every }g_E(\Sigma_0),\ E\in\mathcal R(C),\text{ belongs to its labelled interval in }\mathfrak I_{n,\alpha}(\widehat C_n)\right\}\geq1-\alpha.\] The conclusion permits duplicate effect values and singular joint effect covariance.

review.note: After unfolding the sampling world, selected effect set, component effect set, coverage event, confidence collection, and convergence predicate, Lean states Hausdorff-distance convergence in probability and the equivalent eventual-epsilon formulation of the advertised liminf labelled-familywise coverage; zero-extension outside finite Q preserves the finite-dimensional effect vectors, while duplicate values and singular joint effect covariance remain unrestricted.

nl.statement: Using \(\mathsf H_{\mathrm{opt}}\), characterize the Pareto frontier of universal exact separator schemes for \(\mathfrak S_p\) in the two coordinates consisting of the maximum number of active target blocks and the maximum rational height. In particular, determine for which \(p\) the achieved pair \((2,\lceil\log_2p\rceil)\) can be improved in either coordinate without worsening the other, while every scheme must still separate every pair with unequal static signatures by an observable polynomial certificate.

review.note: The non-Prop string preserves the H_opt route, both Pareto coordinates, achieved upper point, per-p improvement question, universal certificate requirement, known partial bound, undefined criteria, and explicit nonassertion; it has no delivered theorem consumer.

nl.statement: Let \(G_0\) and \(G_1\) be finite directed acyclic graphs on the same labelled vertex set.  They have the same skeleton and the same unshielded colliders if and only if they are Markov equivalent.  If they are equivalent and \(m\) adjacencies have opposite orientations, then there is a sequence of exactly \(m\) distinct covered-edge reversals from \(G_0\) to \(G_1\); every intermediate graph is acyclic and equivalent, and each reversal corrects one original orientation disagreement.

review.note: After unfolding the cited carrier and sequence predicate, Lean quantifies finite DAGs on one labelled vertex type, states the skeleton-and-unshielded-collider characterization biconditionally, and provides exactly edgeDiffCount many distinct covered reversals with DAG endpoints, equivalence at every stage, and every reversed adjacency oriented oppositely in the original and target graphs.

nl.statement: For proper blocked edge-coloured directed acyclic graphs, in which every edge-colour block has at least two members, equality of the associated linear Gaussian covariance models implies equality of the coloured directed acyclic graphs.

review.note: BlockedState encodes exactly an acyclic target-local edge-colour partition, the explicit cardinality premises encode proper colouring for both graphs, and covModel equality implying state equality is equivalent to uniqueness within each BPEC model-equivalence class.

nl.statement:
For every \(C,D\in\mathfrak S_p\), if \(\mathsf S(C)\neq\mathsf S(D)\), then
\[
\mathcal W_2(C)\not\subseteq\mathcal M(D)
\qquad\text{or}\qquad
\mathcal W_2(D)\not\subseteq\mathcal M(C).
\]
Moreover, for every \(E_0\in\mathfrak S_p\), writing \(b_j=|\Pi^{E_0}_j|\),
\[
|\mathcal W_2(E_0)|
=\sum_{j\in V}\left(b_j+\binom{b_j}{2}\right)
=\sum_{j\in V}\binom{b_j+1}{2}
\leq\binom{p+1}{3}
\leq\frac{p^2(p-1)}{2}.
\]
The bound \(\binom{p+1}{3}\) is sharp for every \(p\geq1\): equality is attained by a transitively oriented complete directed acyclic graph whose parent partitions consist entirely of singleton blocks.

review.note: The Lean statement exactly matches separation, both count identities, both bounds, and sharp attainment; an acyclic complete orientation in `BlockedState` is precisely a transitive tournament, and `[Nonempty V]` enforces p ≥ 1.
